review_findings.deletion_math: Group logsumexp and within-group conditional averages reproduce direct remaining-key normalization without subtraction of near-equal masses. Every query event vector removes the same donor. Same-person mass is masked before normalization; deleting an already excluded own donor is an ineligible duplicate null.
review_findings.proper_score_and_prior: All arms use the same coherent ten-pattern distribution and uniform prior; event marginals lie within the common loose interval[.001,.999], safely inside the1e-6 clip. Each fixed forecast has mean9 proper binary log loss. Worst-deletion and DRO objectives are robust training objectives, not ordinary calibration guarantees. Missing raw atom support remains reported and the prior does not restore a learnable absent-event direction.
review_findings.query_group_dro: participant_weights=N/(G*n_g) and multipliers=G*softmax(logweights)_g give primary per-record weight N*q_g/n_g. The update sums detached primary losses and scales by N/(batch_size*n_g); it is a shuffled-minibatch estimate, not a conditionally unbiased adaptive full-data oracle. Current source and contract explicitly qualify that limitation. Auxiliary receives no DRO multiplier.
review_findings.leakage: Every supervised array is sliced to innertrain before fitting statistics/thresholds. prediction_inputs touches only held prefix. Training memory is built only from innertrain and excluded-own-group prediction has zero same-person label/score effect. Eligible memory labels and supervised query labels correctly affect predictions or loss/gradients in positive controls.
review_findings.historical_correspondence: Child and evaluation paths enforce frozen-parent preprocessing, shared initialization and minibatch-order hashes. New retrieval arms additionally match memory hashes. Parent source hashes were independently checked against its public frozen map. Historical heads remain reused references with different heads/deployment memory resources, not newly trained matched controls. Current metadata_check additionally verifies all18 parent frozen source hashes against disk; synthetic constructor test additionally matches public historical initialization hashes.
review_findings.output_sealing: Parent pins each of12 receipts plus predictions,weights,trace,stats,memory:72 artifacts. Prediction schema covers full-memory and all ordered donor counterfactuals, group mass/support/DRO state. The once-only OUTPUT_SEAL is verified before the first held event-label operation and again after scoring. Held-label worst-donor selection is secondary post-seal scoring only.
review_findings.budget_and_failure: Atomic canonical ledger consumes starts/failures and rejects another running campaign. Parent per-job process ownership and whole-worker SIGALRM cleanup preserve kill/reap responsibility across pending alarms. Launch/loading/checkpoint/pinning/evaluation are charged; first failure closes batch without promotion. Frozen request config/fold/method identity is enforced.
review_findings.evaluation: Full-memory participant-macro loss is primary. Existing2percent Markov/HGB and2fold screen is retained; operator screen additionally requires advantage over ERM/random deletion in overall loss and at least2folds. Query-DRO comparison is separately retained. Event frequencies/losses, invalid versus valid-all-zero groups, donor concentration/entropy/effective count, support deficits and actual memory/artifact/inference costs are preserved.
review_findings.privacy: Seven source inputs are explicitly allowlisted. No raw reprocessing/download/dev-test access. .gitignore excludes local memory,weights,rows,traces,tokens/logs; ignore behavior was checked using path strings only.

resolved_pre_freeze_findings: Added record/person-macro event frequencies, donor entropy, storage costs and full-plus-counterfactual inference time required by the written method.
Removed unqualified unbiased full-data risk claim for adaptive shuffled-minibatch query-group DRO.
Separated person-macro primary trace diagnostic from optimized primary including DRO multipliers.

synthetic_validation.scope: Synthetic arrays,model forward/backward,functional controller/seal checks. The training-failure test replaces AdamW with a step that raises before any update; no actual optimizer fitting occurred.

limitations: Actual input bytes/identity alignment and runtime feasibility are not yet verified; this review authorizes only their subsequent source-input binding.
No accuracy, donor mechanism, novelty, calibration or generalization claim is approved. Source34people are historically exposed exploratory folds.
The learning operator instantiates established weighted retrieval,minimax deletion and exponential weighting; composition alone does not establish high novelty.
Same forward deletion menu is computed for all arms; backward work differs, so equal FLOPs are not established.
Query-specific worst-donor risk is not deletion of one shared donor across the population. Held labels select worst donors only after sealed forecasts, and this risk is not the issued forecast.
Operator screen excludes query-group-DRO from its Boolean conjunction but retains that comparison; failure to beat that control weakens donor-side necessity even if the narrower screen passes.
Entropy or a finite prior alone does not demonstrate useful forecasts or missing-support learnability.
Historical HGB representation and parametric heads/inference resources differ; infer the deletion operator effect primarily from the matched new retrieval arms.
Training traces are online changing-model averages with objective-specific primary losses; they are not endpoint fitted-training scores.
